pois.name: Elizabeth Tower
pois.description: The 96m Gothic Revival clock tower (1859), housing the 13.7-tonne Great Bell. Known as Big Ben after the bell. Restored to its original terracotta-red in 2022.

pois.name: Westminster Abbey
pois.description: England's coronation church since 1066. Every English monarch crowned here. 3,300 people buried within, including Darwin, Newton and Chaucer.

pois.name: Buckingham Palace
pois.description: The official London residence of the British monarch since 1837. 775 rooms. The Changing of the Guard happens in the forecourt daily at 11 am.

pois.name: Trafalgar Square
pois.description: London's public piazza. Nelson's Column (51.6m) commemorates the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar. The Fourth Plinth hosts rotating contemporary art commissions.

pois.name: Palace of Westminster
pois.description: Barry and Pugin's Gothic Revival masterpiece (1870). The House of Commons and Lords sit here. The 300m river facade is best seen from the South Bank.
